import List
import Map
import String
import Decode
import Int

let rec_dec = Decode.map2 (fn e m -> (e, m)) (Decode.field "endpoint" Decode.string) (Decode.field "ms" Decode.int)

let rank p n = (p * n + 99) / 100

let pick p vs =
  let n = List.length vs;
  match List.get (rank p n - 1) vs with
  | Some v -> v
  | None -> 0

let step acc line =
  if String.empty? (String.trim line) then acc
  else
    match Decode.run rec_dec line with
    | Ok (e, m) ->
      if m >= 0 then
        let old = Map.get e acc.0 |> Option.default [];
        (Map.set e (m :: old) acc.0, acc.1)
      else (acc.0, acc.1 + 1)
    | Error _ -> (acc.0, acc.1 + 1)

let (groups, skipped) = IO.stdin_lines () |> Stream.fold_left step (Map.empty, 0)

let keys = Map.keys groups |> List.sort
List.each (fn k ->
  let vs = Map.get k groups |> Option.default [] |> List.sort;
  IO.println "%{k} count=%{List.length vs} p50=%{pick 50 vs} p95=%{pick 95 vs}") keys
if skipped > 0 then IO.println "skipped %{skipped}" else ()
EOF

uses {IO}

let parse_line line =
  match JSON.parse line with
  | Error _ -> None
  | Ok j ->
    match (JSON.field "endpoint" j, JSON.field "ms" j) with
    | (Ok e, Ok m) ->
      match (JSON.get_string e, JSON.get_int m) with
      | (Ok s, Ok n) -> if n >= 0 then Some (s, n) else None
      | _ -> None
    | _ -> None

let rank p n = (p * n + 99) / 100

let pick p vs =
  match List.get (rank p (List.length vs) - 1) vs with
  | Some v -> v
  | None -> 0

let step acc line =
  let (m, k) = acc
  if String.empty? (String.trim line) then acc
  else
    match parse_line line with
    | Some (e, n) -> (Map.update e [] (fn xs -> n :: xs) m, k)
    | None -> (m, k + 1)

let (m, k) = IO.stdin_lines () |> Stream.fold_left step (Map.empty, 0)
List.each (fn e ->
  let vs = List.sort (Map.get! e m)
  IO.println "%{e} count=%{List.length vs} p50=%{pick 50 vs} p95=%{pick 95 vs}") (List.sort (Map.keys m))
if k > 0 then IO.println "skipped %{k}" else ()
